svg.title: Artha identity and household isolation architecture
svg.desc: Authentication and tenant isolation through verified tokens, household membership, composite foreign keys and row-level security.

g.text: Every request resolves to one verified person and one allowed household.
Normal production authentication and server-owned request context
Defence continues below the API; tenant isolation does not depend on UI filtering
No service-role key in normal user paths • The demo identity follows the same authentication and RLS path
